item.title: Latest Forecast with Chief Meteorologist Mike LaPoint
item.description: Temperatures will continue to climb back into the upper 80s and lower 90s through the latter part of the week before another cold front slides south through the region on Friday. No rain is expected this week, but the above normal temperatures and low afternoon humidity will lead to a continued threat for grass fires.
